hints.title: Independent Subsequence Decoupling
hints.text: An array is k-increasing if each of the k interleaved subsequences modulo k is non-decreasing.

hints.title: Longest Non-Decreasing Retention
hints.text: To minimize replacements in each chain, keep the maximum number of elements forming a non-decreasing order.

hints.title: Binary Search Patience Sorting
hints.text: Apply bisect right on tails to find the longest non-decreasing subsequence length and subtract from chain length.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N log(N / K)) longest non-decreasing subsequence per interleaved chain
complexity.notes: Array decouples into K independent chains; min operations = chain_length - length_of_longest_non_decreasing_subsequence.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Dynamic programming on chains without binary search takes quadratic time per chain.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bisect right on patient tails finds longest non-decreasing subsequence in logarithmic time per element.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that K-increasing partitions into K independent LIS subproblems.
